# Shark Bait (book)

Shark Bait is a children's action and adventure novel by Australian author Justin D'Ath, first published in 2006 by Penguin Group Australia as the third installment in the Extreme Adventures series. [1] [2] The story centers on 14-year-old Sam Fox, who, while on family holiday at the Great Barrier Reef, is swept into the open ocean by a freak wave along with a young Japanese tourist named Michi, leading to a desperate fight for survival against drowning and encroaching sharks.

...

## Publication history Copy link to section Listen to this section

'''Shark Bait''' was first published on 1 May 2006 by Penguin Group Australia (imprint Puffin Books) in paperback format with 144 pages and ISBN 9780143302216. This Australian edition marked its debut as the third book in Justin D'Ath's Extreme Adventures series. A concurrent eBook edition was also released with ISBN 9781742280943. [1] [2] [20] The book has primarily been published in paperback with a core length of 144 pages in its Australian and initial international distributions. Later editions include a 2010 US release by Kane Miller (ISBNs 9781935279709 and 9781610671194, with some variation to 137 pages) and a 2011 UK edition by A&C Black (ISBN 9781408126455, 142 pages). Digital formats have been available since 2006. No hardcover or large-print editions are documented. The title remains in print through various Penguin imprints and licensees. [20]

### Description

The legend continues! Stand by for more adventures with the world’s greatest secret agent, as some of his most thrilling missions are collected for the first time ever!

Shark Bait, a story never before published in the UK, sees 007 facing off against a new nemesis… and a sea of hungry sharks! When a routine recon mission is interupted by an underwater attack by the gorgeous Katya Orlova, a Russian spy with a vendetta against MI-6, Bond is left with only one choice: kill or be killed! 

This new, never-before-collected edition also includes Doomcrack and another, never-before-seen in the UK story, The Xanadu Connection! Plus a new introduction by Caroline Bliss, a.k.a. Ms Moneypenny and an exclusive feature on James Bond US comics!
